note: New knowledge pack (ticket #806, frontend wave 2). Fences: reactivity-facts owns reactivity MECHANISM (signal/computed/effect kernel internals, disposal, async-staleness guards, scheduling clocks) — this pack owns app-tier state ARCHITECTURE judgment (stacked generations, tagged-union-vs-same-fact, adoption verdicts, never-pulled triggers, doctrine-vs-practice divergence, one-name-two-owners). ui-pattern-facts owns UI-pattern naming and the screen-state grammar (loading/empty/error), unrelated territory. make-component owns a component's own anatomy/API realization. Amended ticket #807 (frontend wave 3): persistence-facts owns client-persistence facts specifically (storage discipline tiers, dual sync/async contracts, the storage-specific bypass-inventory shape citing this pack's own audit-technique.md as the general method, URL-state sync) — n13 is the reciprocal no-trigger case. Amended ticket #808 (frontend wave 4): data-wiring-facts owns one specific wiring decision (streaming stack, bridge protocol, no-DI substitutes, the wiring-pattern menu), not whole-app architecture drift — n14 is the reciprocal no-trigger case.
